name: Perth AI
tagline: Western Australia's community for people building with AI.
description: Perth AI is a community for builders, startups, students, enterprises and product teams working with AI in Western Australia. Meet-ups, co-building sessions, workshops and networking — all on Whadjuk Noongar boodja.
_logo: Path to the real Perth AI quokka logo in public/, e.g. '/logo-quokka.svg'. Leave empty to use the placeholder mark in src/components/Logo.astro.
_luma: PLACEHOLDER: `luma` is a guess at the calendar URL and needs replacing with the real one. `lumaEmbedId` accepts either a bare calendar ID (cal-XXXX) or the full iframe src from Luma → Calendar → Settings → Embed; paste whichever and events appear automatically.

mailingList.note: Leave formAction empty to send people straight to Luma. Paste a Mailchimp/Buttondown/Kit form action URL here to collect emails directly instead.

summit.name: AI Disrupt Summit
summit.blurb: Our flagship event and a satellite of West Tech Fest.
